register.summaryZh: TAKE 表達可以清楚說明某人是同行、被送回、被帶到樓上、被送走,還是被帶着經過某個地方。；你可以用 TAKE 描述驚訝、家族相似之處、突然產生的反感、逐漸形成的好感和濃厚興趣。；take on、take upon yourself 和 take over 可用來談論承擔職務、接受責任和取得控制權。；take your breath away、take your eyes off 和 take a leaf out of somebody’s book 等表達,常見於對話、故事、評論和新聞報道。
register.summaryEn: TAKE expressions can show whether somebody is being brought along, taken back, moved upstairs, transported away or guided through a place. You can use TAKE to describe surprise, family resemblance, sudden dislike, growing affection and strong interest. Take on, take upon yourself and take over help you discuss accepting duties, taking responsibility and gaining control. Expressions such as take your breath away, take your eyes off and take a leaf out of somebody’s book are common in conversations, stories, reviews and news reports.

fixedVariable.variableZh: 保留原句中的人物、事物、時間、結果和意思。；使用 it、him 或 them 等短詞時,請按照以上例子的語序。；有些表達的外形相似,但意思可以完全不同。例如,take off 可以表示飛機起飛、某人突然離開、模仿某人,或除去某物。
fixedVariable.variableEn: Keep the same people, things, time, result and meaning. When using a short word such as it, him or them, follow the word order shown in examples such as: take it apart take him aside take them along take it off take it out Some expressions look similar but have very different meanings. For example, take off can describe an aircraft leaving the ground, a person leaving suddenly, imitating somebody or removing something.
